title: Design, synthesis, biological evaluation, and molecular dynamics study of asymmetric N-isopropyl-4-piperidone diarylpentanoids as potential anticancer and anti-inflammatory agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22713-22734

Novel asymmetric N-isopropyl-4-piperidone diarylpentanoids were rationally designed with a push–pull system. Compound KB2d emerges as a potent dual anticancer and anti-inflammatory agent.
